reconciliation.why: the 10-Q tags the fixed-asset impairment and the restructuring and impairment line rose against the prior-year quarter and six months, as the note states.
net PP&E fell from the year-end balance and the impairment is tagged on assets held for use, as expected for a write-down.
the 10-Q tags negative measurement-period adjustments to acquired inventory, PP&E and intangibles; the receivables adjustment is stated in prose only but runs the same way.
the goodwill roll-forward tags goodwill acquired in Industrial for the six months and the tagged adjustment matches the prose.

the six-month payment to acquire businesses tagged in the cash-flow statement, {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.parts.this_year_to_date.value}, is the amount the note describes as Basler indebtedness paid.
a realised gain is tagged for the quarter, the fair-value table no longer lists equity securities, and proceeds from sale of PP&E and other rose sharply.
proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment rose against a year earlier, consistent with the held-for-sale and Polytronics proceeds in that line.
the tagged quarterly and six-month rates fell against the prior year.
the first-quarter rate was lower than the second-quarter rate, consistent with a first-quarter benefit, but no fact isolates the statute-lapse amount by quarter.
no tagged 10-Q fact carries the reversal; the only figure is the release's own footnote, and the 10-Q text does not mention it.

net sales rose {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} and net income {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year|pct} year over year; the earlier expectation is not in the input, so the size of the beat is not testable.
forward guidance; no reported figure exists yet.
no bookings fact is tagged and the statement appears only in the release.
the release's covenant schedule adds back impairment and restructuring and reports leverage far below the trigger.
the release states the same increase and trailing dividends paid are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.dividends_paid}, up year to date.

the release shows a large 'all other' financing inflow where there was an outflow a year earlier and diluted shares rose; the release's line and MD&A's figure are not the same amount and neither document reconciles them.
SG&A rose as stated; employee-related accrued liabilities nonetheless fell from the year-end balance.
Electronics net sales rose year over year.
gross profit rose and the quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} is the highest of the six filled quarters.
Electronics segment operating income rose sharply on higher sales.
Transportation operating income and margin fell despite higher sales.
auto sensor net sales fell year over year.
the decline is confirmed by the auto sensor sales fact; no number can say whether the cause is car builds or a strategic exit, so the attribution difference stays open.
the Industrial operating margin fell while segment sales rose.
Industrial net sales rose and the release and pro forma facts attribute most of the increase to Basler.
the record tags China, the United States and other countries; other countries rose, and no fact isolates Europe or its semiconductor and passenger-car volume.
the foreign exchange line turned from a loss to a gain in the quarter and year to date.
operating cash flow rose as stated and net income rose with it; the statement also shows payables supplying cash while receivables and inventory absorbed it, which the prose omits.
no fact for the reclassification of accumulated other comprehensive income is in the record, and the item looks forward.
interest expense and interest paid already fell year over year, though the driver in the numbers is debt repayment rather than the swap.

anomalies.name: income more volatile than cash
anomalies.what: Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}: quarter-to-quarter changes in net income vary far more than changes in operating cash flow. The cause is the fourth-quarter impairments of fiscal 2024 and fiscal 2025 in net income. There is no sign of income being smoothed against cash; the opposite is true.

anomalies.name: annual days sales outstanding at a five-year high
anomalies.name_ko: 연간 매출채권 회수기간이 오 년 최고치
anomalies.what: Fiscal 2025 days sales outstanding of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} and receivables over revenue of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue} were the highest of the five filled years, up from {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}. The quarter this 10-Q reports shows {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the lowest of six quarters, so the year-end build has not extended; the prose does not discuss collection terms.

anomalies.name: soft-asset share near its high
anomalies.what: Soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, the third highest of six quarters, after the first-quarter high of {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share}; fiscal 2025 was {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}. Basler goodwill and intangibles drive it, and the measurement-period shift into goodwill adds to it. Benign reading: an acquisition-led balance sheet, not capitalised operating cost.

anomalies.name: covenant EBITDA now adds back restructuring
anomalies.name_ko: 구조조정 비용을 가산하도록 바뀐 약정 EBITDA
anomalies.what: "The Credit Agreement was amended in Q1 2026 and now allows to add restructuring charges and business optimization expenses in addition to the prior credit agreement." The amendment coincides with the rise in restructuring and site-closure charges; leverage remains far below the trigger, so the effect is on the definition, not on compliance.

anomalies.name: commitments, guarantees and supplier finance untagged
anomalies.what: Proceeds from sale of receivables, supplier-finance obligations, unconditional purchase obligations and guarantee maximum exposure are all absent from the record in every period ("the companyfacts record tags none of us-gaap:SupplierFinanceProgramObligation in any period"), and the text carried does not mention any of them. Operating lease liability is stated only at the fiscal year end at {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability}. Off-balance-sheet exposure cannot be sized from this input.

anomalies.name: share-based compensation rising
anomalies.what: Trailing share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, above {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2025, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2024 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.share_based_compensation} in fiscal 2023. It is a real cost paid in shares; it is already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} and its excess tax benefit lowered the reported tax rate.

anomalies.name: passenger-vehicle decline attributed differently
anomalies.name_ko: 승용차 매출 감소 원인의 문서 간 차이
anomalies.what: The release says "Passenger vehicle sales were impacted by lower global passenger car builds and auto sensor product declines." while MD&A says the decline was "driven by the strategic exit of certain lower margin products". The auto sensor sales fact confirms the decline; nothing in the numbers says whether it was the market or a choice. One framing is external and temporary, the other elective and lasting.

anomalies.name: pension charge timing moved between filings
anomalies.name_ko: 공시 사이에 옮겨진 연금 정산비용 시점
anomalies.what: The notes reader could not tell whether the expected quarter had moved because the prior wording was not in its input; the tags answer it: "The first-quarter 10-Q tagged the same range for 2026-06-28..2026-09-26, so the forecast period has moved later." The prose gives no reason for the move.

anomalies.name: 'record bookings' only in the release
anomalies.what: The release expects growth "supported by record bookings, continued customer momentum, and contributions from the Basler acquisition"; the 10-Q paragraphs carried do not mention bookings and no bookings or backlog fact is tagged. The demand claim behind next quarter's guidance rests on the release alone.

anomalies.name: distributor and China concentration
anomalies.what: Arrow Electronics was {concentration.facts.8.value|pct} of fiscal 2025 revenue against {concentration.facts.5.value|pct} in fiscal 2024 and {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} in fiscal 2023; China was {concentration.facts.7.value|pct} against {concentration.facts.4.value|pct}; non-US sales were {concentration.facts.6.value|pct}. China net sales rose in the quarter. A distributor near a tenth of revenue makes the sales-discount reserve and channel inventory matter, and the reserve ratio is thinning.

anomalies.name: purchase commitments untagged
anomalies.what: Unconditional purchase obligations are absent from the record in every period and the text carried does not state them, so purchase commitments in excess of need cannot be tested. With inventory rising to {terms.balances_now.inventory} and two semiconductor sites closing, the size of any take-or-pay commitments would matter.

adjustments.name: payables supplied operating cash
adjustments.quote: Change in accounts payable provided 39,159 (thousands) of operating cash in the six months to 2026-06-27, against a use of 7,001 a year earlier. Balance-sheet accounts payable is 248,972 against 211,079 at 2025-12-27.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 영업현금흐름 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}는 순이익을 크게 웃돌지만, 후행 사분기 순이익 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income}이 2025 회계연도 영업권 손상차손 때문에 마이너스여서 비율 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}은 해석할 수 없다. 매출채권·재고·매입채무의 대차대조표 변동과 현금흐름표 변동의 차이는 Basler 인수로 설명되며, 매입채무 증가가 이번 기간 영업현금의 일부를 공급했다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 이번 분기 매출채권 회수기간은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 낮아 매출채권이 매출을 앞서지 않는다. 다만 판매할인·공제 충당금 비율이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio}로 얇아지고 이연수익 {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}가 매출 증가와 반대로 줄어든 점은 작지만 불리한 방향이다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 재고 충당금 비율이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}로 전분기 {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}보다 낮아졌고, 실효세율 하락은 공소시효 만료와 주식보상 초과세혜택 같은 일회성 항목 때문이다. Basler 측정기간 조정으로 무형자산·재고·유형자산 가치가 영업권으로 옮겨져 향후 상각비가 줄고, 연금 정산비용은 2027년으로 미뤄졌다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 태그되지 않아 측정할 수 없고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense}는 전액 비용 처리된다. 그러나 '비경상' 구조조정·손상 비용이 매년 반복되며 커지고 회사의 비GAAP 조정폭도 넓어져, 후행 영업이익률 {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct}은 삼 년 평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}를 밑돈다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망금융은 태그되지 않았고 본문에도 없다. 매입채무가 전년 현금 사용에서 올해 현금 공급으로 바뀌어 후행 사분기 변동 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change}를 품질조정 잉여현금흐름에서 차감했으며, 주식보상비용 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}은 실제 비용으로 이미 차감되어 있다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제는 유효하다고 보고됐고 감사인 검토보고서는 입력에 없다. 10-K와 10-Q 사이에 Basler 인수일 영업권이 조용히 수정됐고, 10-K에 2024 회계연도 매출원가·재고 조정이 설명 없이 태그됐으며, 2026년 초 세 건의 임원 변경 8-K가 있다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K 실적 발표와 10-Q는 두 문서가 함께 싣는 모든 숫자에서 일치하며 분기 영업현금흐름 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}도 같다. 불일치는 금액이 아니라 설명에 있다: 세금혜택의 분기 배치, 승용차 매출 감소의 원인, 영업현금흐름 증가의 원인, 그리고 연금 정산비용 시점이 2026년 세 번째 분기에서 2027년 첫 번째 분기로 옮겨진 점이다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고 회전일수가 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 낮아 재고가 빨리 돌고 있으나, 반도체 공장 두 곳 폐쇄에 재고 평가손실은 태그되지 않았다. Arrow Electronics 비중은 {concentration.facts.8.value|pct}, 중국 비중은 {concentration.facts.7.value|pct}이며, 구매약정은 태그되지 않아 판단할 수 없고 고객에 대한 순환거래 징후는 없다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
